Every way forward fails: going to number 3, every way of continuing runs into a dead end within a few moves; going down leaves no safe move afterwards; going around the edge to (5,4) would leave number 3 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So my guess (left from cell (1,5)) was wrong, so the line must go around the edge to (5,5).

Number 7 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Going up would leave number 8 unreachable without crossing a higher number. So the line goes left.
Number 8 is next and right here, so the line takes it.
Every cell is covered and the numbers are in order. Case closed!
